capture_integrity: Not inferred from XML. Confirm recorder success separately; partial and failed recordings can still contain readable rows.

cumulative_counter_cross_check.method: Last minus first cumulative CPU time; counters are never summed. Live counters use closed interval ends and exclude the final potentially extrapolated interval.

cpu.interpretation: 100% is one fully occupied CPU core; this is process CPU, not plugin-only CPU.

frames.interpretation: Hitches use recorded presentation deadlines. No fixed-refresh-rate dropped-frame estimate is made.

display_fps_estimate.scope: Device display estimate; no PID attribution

target_process_fps.reason: This schema has no process or surface-owner attribution

display_fps_estimate.interpretation: An estimate of display activity, not target-app animation FPS or a dropped-frame count. Static screens and variable refresh rates must not be judged against a fixed 60/120 FPS target.

render_commits.interpretation: Render commits are not model computations, reloadData calls or reloadRows calls.

group_sampling.reason: No attributed samples with usable weight units

per_round_duration.reason: The unmodified 2.2-8 build has no per-round event boundaries

group_refresh_call_counts.reason: Sampling and render commits do not count group refresh/reload invocations

window_selection_note: Conservative post-cue scrolling window; the start-scrolling cue was delayed, so this excludes the initial waiting/preparation period.

capture_context.frame_scope_proof: TOC recorded attached PID 37813 and coreanimation-lifetime-interval target-pid=SINGLE.
